top.headline: New Etihad Rail Stations Open in Dubai and Sharjah
top.summary: Etihad Rail opened new passenger stations in Dubai and Sharjah to accommodate high public demand. The expansion improves connectivity across the emirates.

top.title: Etihad Rail announces more trains between Abu Dhabi and Dubai to meet demand

top.headline: Etihad Rail Adds Extra Services Between Dubai and Abu Dhabi
top.summary: Following strong early interest, Etihad Rail introduced extra train trips and thousands of new tickets between Abu Dhabi and Dubai. High weekend demand prompted the rapid service expansion.

top.headline: Tenant Queries Responsibility for Installing EV Charger at Rented Villa
